dataset.provenance: Database Group Leipzig North Carolina Voters 5M benchmark, deterministic sample of the first 5,000 recid values in source 0 and their records across all five sources. Source: https://leutzsch.informatik.uni-leipzig.de/research/projects/benchmark-datasets-for-entity-resolution
dataset.permission: Database Group Leipzig publishes the benchmark datasets under a Creative Commons license. Accessed 2026-09-19.
dataset.labelingMethod: The benchmark recid field is the ground-truth entity cluster identifier across sources.
dataset.duplicateDefinition: Two rows are duplicates when they share recid. DedupeSafe received givenname as First Name, surname as Last Name, and suburb as Company context; Email and Phone were blank.
dataset.anonymization: Raw public benchmark rows were processed only in a local temporary directory, were not committed, and will be deleted after evaluation. The saved report contains no names, contact values, or recid values.
